big_picture.title: Stock Market Bashed As Election Results Heighten AI Sector Concerns; Nasdaq Takes Out A Key Level
big_picture.excerpt: These tech stocks have all fallen below a major moving average.
paragraphs: The stock market on Thursday illustrated how postelection investor euphoria can last all but a day.

All of the major stock market indexes took a true thumping. Investors gave a fresh vote of fear on the future of investment in artificial intelligence. No doubt, AI has contributed to significant growth in the U.S. economy in recent years. But perhaps a historic Democratic Party sweep of power in Congress following Tuesday's midterm elections, plus huge wins for the same political party at myriad state and city elections, is giving investors second thoughts.
